evidence.reason: PSA.60.5 (Hebrew 60:7) imperative ענ with pronominal suffix means answer. The OSHB code 6032 does not identify this Hebrew sense; the parallel MACULA qere uses 6030. The lexical root is ענה, conventionally vocalized עָנָה; the qere lemma עֲנָה is an inflected-form vocalization. Only this token is overridden.
